## Fundamentals #0098: Workday: 3Q2027 results

Date: 2026-11-25 14:31
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-25-0098/


Workday (WDAY) revenue grew by 11.2% year over year in the third quarter of fiscal year 2027 to 2.71 billion USD, and EPS grew by 2.1% year over year to 0.96 USD.

### Quarterly results

Operating income was 329.00 million USD compared to 259.00 million USD a year earlier (+27.0% year over year). Operating margin stood at 12.1% compared to 10.7% a year earlier. Net income was 237.00 million USD compared to 252.00 million USD a year earlier (−6.0% year over year). Adjusted EPS was 2.82 USD compared to 2.32 USD a year earlier (+21.6% year over year).

### Company guidance

The company expects subscription revenue in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2027 to be at the level of 2.60 billion USD and for the full fiscal year 2027 to be at the level of 9.958 billion USD. The company forecasts subscription revenue growth in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2027 by 10.0%, and for the full fiscal year 2027 by 13.0%. The company expects adjusted operating margin in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2027 to be at the level of 31.7%, and for the full fiscal year 2027 to be at the level of 31.5%.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that the company delivers AI-based products that customers can use today. According to management, customers are moving from experimenting to implementing and paying for AI solutions. Management noted that demand for AI is strong and monetizing these products is gaining momentum. According to management, in the coming years, helping customers transition from investing in AI to its mass usage with measurable results will be key. Management expressed optimism for the next year due to the wide range of new products. The CEO views the AI consumption-based billing model as an opportunity for margin growth in the future.


---

## Fundamentals #0097: Autodesk: 3Q2027 results

Date: 2026-11-25 14:10
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-25-0097/


Autodesk (ADSK) revenue grew 16.6% year over year to 2.16 billion USD, and earnings per share grew 67.5% year over year to 2.68 USD.

### Quarterly results

Operating income was 551.00 million USD compared to 470.00 million USD a year earlier (+17.2% year over year). Net income reached 563.00 million USD compared to 343.00 million USD a year earlier (+64.1% year over year). Adjusted earnings per share was 3.20 USD compared to 2.67 USD a year earlier (+19.9% year over year).

### Company guidance

The company expects revenue in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2027 to be at a level of 2.22 billion USD – 2.235 billion USD, and for the full fiscal year 2027 in the range of 8.36 billion USD – 8.375 billion USD. The company forecasts adjusted earnings per share in fiscal year 2027 at a level of 12.70–12.76 USD and billings in the range of 8.60 billion USD – 8.65 billion USD. The company expects earnings per share (GAAP) in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2027 in the range of 2.64 USD – 3.02 USD, while for the full fiscal year 2027 in the range of 9.98 USD – 10.35 USD. The company forecasts operating margin (GAAP) in fiscal year 2027 at approximately 27.0% and adjusted operating margin in the range of 39.2% – 39.3%. The company expects free cash flows in fiscal year 2027 in the range of 2.725 billion USD – 2.75 billion USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that the company had a strong quarter and signed the largest corporate contract in its history with a client. According to management, artificial intelligence represents an exceptional opportunity to increase the value of software for customers, and falling AI costs allow for the automation of more processes. Management emphasized that with highly automated processes, the company will earn from some of them. According to management, the acquired MaintainX business slightly exceeded expectations, and interest in maintenance solutions is very high. Management emphasized that contract renewals remain strong, demand in key markets is healthy, and the company enters the final quarter of the year from a position of strength. According to management, long-term growth potential remains relevant, and the company is well on track with its established plans.


---

## Fundamentals #0095: Analog Devices: 4Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-25 09:10
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-25-0095/


Analog Devices (ADI) revenue increased in the quarter by 42.2% year over year to 4.37 billion USD, and earnings per share increased by 112.5% year over year to 3.40 USD.

### Quarterly results

Gross margin was 69.3% compared to 63.1% a year earlier (+6.2 pp year over year). Operating income reached 1.87 billion USD compared to 945.21 million USD a year earlier (+97.7% year over year), and net income was 1.65 billion USD compared to 787.74 million USD a year earlier (+109.5% year over year). Operating margin was 42.7% compared to 30.7% a year earlier (+12.0 pp year over year), while adjusted earnings per share was 4.06 USD compared to 2.26 USD a year earlier (+79.6% year over year).

### Company guidance

The company expects revenue in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 to be in the range of 4.25 billion USD to 4.55 billion USD. The company forecasts operating margin (GAAP) in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 in the range of 38.8% – 41.8%, adjusted operating margin at the level of 49.5% – 51.5%, and earnings per share (GAAP) from 2.82 USD to 3.22 USD. The company also forecasts adjusted earnings per share in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 in the range of 3.62–4.02 USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that demand remains strong, and order cancellations are staying at normal levels, which allows the company to believe it is still in the middle of the cycle. According to management, artificial intelligence is only at the beginning of its expansion as a key technology that will affect all other technologies. Management emphasized that due to a strong project portfolio and growth dynamics, confidence in future growth has increased, resulting in further expansion of production capacity. According to management, production capacities are tight both in their own factories and with external manufacturers, which is a phenomenon observed across the entire industry. Management also emphasized that customers are solving increasingly difficult problems at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds, for which the company is prepared to provide increasing value. According to management, there are no signs yet of significant inventory rebuilding among customers.

## Log #0236: Session summary 2026-11-23: NDX 26746.10 (+6.86%)

Date: 2026-11-24 07:49
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/posts/log-0236/


**Session date:** 2026-11-23

> *Session close 2026-11-23: NDX 26746.10 (+6.86%), NQ 26812.50, QQQ 650.87 (+7.00%).*

---

### Session overview

**Overnight and opening.** The NQ contract resumed trading on Sunday at 18:00 ET (Monday 0:00 PL) at 25561.50, 270.50 pts above Friday's last trade (25291.00). At 9:00 ET it stood at 26682.25 and at 9:30 ET at 26878.50. The session started at 9:30 ET (15:30 PL) at NDX level 26889.29, 1860.30 pts (+7.43%) above Friday's close (25028.99).

**First hour.** In the first 15 minutes NDX fell to the day's low of 26386.42 (between 9:40 and 9:45 ET, 15:40–15:45 PL), 502.87 pts below the open. Within the first 30 minutes NQ set both the session high, 27137.00, and the session low, 26450.25. NDX then rose 632.46 pts to the day's high of 27018.88 (between 10:25 and 10:30 ET, 16:25–16:30 PL).

**Rest of the session.** From 11:00 ET to the close NDX moved within 26573.28–26875.53 (302.25 pts). In the last hour it rose 28.44 pts, from 26717.66 at 15:00 ET to the close of 26746.10. The close is 272.78 pts below the high and 359.68 pts above the day's low.

CrowdStrike (CRWD) revenue increased in the quarter by 28.3% year over year to 1.58 billion USD, and earnings per share was 0.02 USD compared to −0.03 USD a year earlier.

### Quarterly results

Adjusted earnings per share was 0.34 USD compared to 0.24 USD a year earlier (+41.7% year over year). Net income reached 24.86 million USD compared to −26.78 million USD a year earlier.

### Company guidance

The company forecasts revenue in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2027 at a level of 1,638.10 million USD – 1,644.10 million USD. The company expects adjusted earnings per share in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2027 at a level of 0.36 USD.

According to management, security has become a driving force, and the company is becoming an entry point for deploying AI in enterprises. Management believes that the timing for the acquisition is right and points to long-term preparations for technology integration. According to management, the combination with the new entity will allow it to become the largest company in the field of AI security.

## Fundamentals #0090: Ross Stores: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-20 01:06
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-20-0090/


> ⚠️ **ERRATUM (2026-11-24)**  
> **The comparison with Q2 did not mention the tariff refunds.**
>
> **Correction:**
> - Q2 operating income (1.10 billion USD) included about 253 million USD of IEEPA tariff refunds (company release of August 20, 2026).
>
> The other figures and dates stay the same.

Ross Stores (ROST) revenue increased in the quarter by 11.7% year over year to 6.26 billion USD, and earnings per share increased by 20.9% year over year to 1.91 USD.

### Quarterly results

Operating income was 766.79 million USD compared to 648.50 million USD a year earlier (+18.2% year over year). Net income reached 606.32 million USD compared to 511.94 million USD a year earlier (+18.4% year over year). Operating income on a quarterly basis was 766.79 million USD compared to 1.10 billion USD in Q2 (−30.5% q/q).

### Company guidance

The company expects comparable store sales growth in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026 at a level of 4.0% – 5.0%. The company forecasts earnings per share in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026 in the range of 2.16–2.25 USD, with earnings per share growth during this period expected to be 8.0% – 13.0%. The company also forecasts earnings per share for the full fiscal year 2026 in the range of 8.75–8.84 USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that growth is being driven mainly by increased foot traffic in stores and the addition of new and returning customers. According to management, the company still sees significant opportunities for gaining market share, and many initiatives are in the early stages. Management stated that the company does not feel competitive pricing pressure that could harm its business. According to management, during the holiday season, results may be weighed down by more expensive domestic transportation and higher expenditures on store wages and marketing.

## Fundamentals #0089: Intuit: 1Q2027 results

Date: 2026-11-20 01:03
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-20-0089/


> ⚠️ **ERRATUM (2026-11-24)**  
> **The entry did not say that the company lowered its full-year revenue guidance.**
>
> **Correction:**
> - On August 25, 2026 the company guided fiscal year 2027 revenue at 23.279–23.512 billion USD; on November 19, 2026 it gave 23.081–23.365 billion USD. According to the release, the change concerns Credit Karma, with an adjustment to the Consumer segment.
>
> The company reaffirmed its fiscal year 2027 guidance for operating income and earnings per share. The other figures and dates stay the same.

Intuit (INTU) revenue grew 12.1% year over year in the quarter to 4.35 billion USD, and earnings per share were 2.59 USD compared to 1.59 USD a year earlier (+62.9% year over year).

### Quarterly results

Operating income was 868.00 million USD compared to 534.00 million USD a year earlier (+62.5% year over year). Net income reached 695.00 million USD compared to 446.00 million USD a year earlier (+55.8% year over year). Adjusted earnings per share were 2.91 USD compared to 1.87 USD a year earlier (+55.6% year over year).

### Company guidance

The company forecasts revenue for fiscal year 2027 at 23.081 billion USD – 23.365 billion USD. The company expects adjusted earnings per share in fiscal year 2027 in the range of 22.88 USD – 23.12 USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized confidence regarding the execution of margin plans and full-year commitments. According to management, a strategy based on an AI-powered platform is key to winning in the market. Management indicated that experience with TurboTax and QuickBooks will improve Credit Karma's visibility over time. Management also announced that upon closing the transaction, all cash from the sale of Mailchimp will be used for share buybacks.

## Fundamentals #0088: Walmart: 3Q2027 results

Date: 2026-11-19 17:34
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-19-0088/


Walmart (WMT) revenue grew in the third quarter of fiscal year 2027 by 5.2% year over year to 188.84 billion USD, while earnings per share fell by 19.5% year over year to 0.62 USD.

### Quarterly results

Operating income was 7.77 billion USD compared to 6.70 billion USD a year earlier (+16.0% year over year). Adjusted earnings per share reached 0.65 USD compared to 0.62 USD a year earlier (+4.8% year over year).

### Company guidance

The company expects net sales growth at constant exchange rates in fiscal year 2027 to be in the range of 4.9% – 5.2%. The company forecasts adjusted operating income growth at constant exchange rates in fiscal year 2027 in the range of 8.0% – 8.6%. The company expects adjusted earnings per share in fiscal year 2027 to be in the range of 2.84–2.89 USD. The company forecasts that capital expenditures as a percentage of net sales in fiscal year 2027 will be approximately 4.0%.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that e-commerce was the main driver for the quarter and that the company continues to gain market share. According to management, AI agents are starting to play an increasing role in shopping, and the company is well-prepared for new ways of buying. Management emphasized that results for the combined membership package are encouraging and the company's goal is to build the most essential membership in the United States. According to management, the growth of e-commerce is driving the growth of profitable services, such as advertising, the seller platform, or membership. Management emphasized that the customer remains stable and resilient, and operating income will grow faster than sales next year.

### Quarterly results

Net income was 482.00 million USD compared to 334.00 million USD a year earlier (+44.3% year over year). Adjusted earnings per share was 1.05 USD compared to 0.93 USD a year earlier (+12.9% year over year). Operating income was 96.00 million USD compared to 309.00 million USD a year earlier (−68.9% year over year).

### Company guidance

The company forecasts revenue in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 at 3.53 billion USD – 3.55 billion USD and for the full fiscal year 2027 in the range of 14.52 billion USD – 14.57 billion USD. The company expects adjusted earnings per share in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 to be 1.01–1.03 USD, and for the full fiscal year 2027 to reach the level of 4.26–4.30 USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that demand was broad, and all of the company's platforms accelerated revenue growth. According to management, higher component costs across the industry will weigh on gross margin throughout the fiscal year. Management emphasized that demand for computing power will grow, however, the company intends to invest prudently and maintain high free cash flow margins even during periods of higher capital expenditures. According to management, companies are still in a very early stage of AI implementation, and most agent applications are still in the testing and pilot phase.

## Fundamentals #0084: NVIDIA: 3Q2027 results

Date: 2026-11-18 01:03
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-18-0084/


NVIDIA (NVDA) revenue grew by 103.2% year over year in the third quarter of fiscal year 2027 to 115.84 billion USD, and earnings per share grew by 107.7% year over year to 2.70 USD.

### Quarterly results

Gross margin was 74.8% compared to 73.4% a year earlier (+1.4 pp year over year). Operating income reached 77.52 billion USD compared to 36.01 billion USD a year earlier (+115.3% year over year), and net income was 65.29 billion USD compared to 31.91 billion USD a year earlier (+104.6% year over year). Adjusted earnings per share was 2.68 USD compared to 1.27 USD a year earlier (+111.0% year over year). Revenue in the Compute & Networking segment was 106.0 billion USD compared to 50.9 billion USD a year earlier (+108% year over year). Revenue in the Graphics segment was 9.8 billion USD compared to 6.1 billion USD a year earlier (+62% year over year).

### Company guidance

The company expects revenue in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2027 in the range of 126.10 billion USD – 133.90 billion USD. The company forecasts adjusted gross margin at a level of 71.0% – 72.0% in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2027.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that the company's momentum is real, and demand is accelerating while supply is simultaneously increasing. According to management, the company has secured supplies of memory and advanced chip packaging. Management also emphasized that in the allocation of limited supplies, all customers receive the same prices.

### Logbook: Mass Expansion and Accretion in a High-Energy Field

**1. Weekly Trajectory and Price Volatility (Monday–Friday Session overview)**
